meta.name: connect
meta.description: Configure or diagnose access to a requested source using available host tools. Use for source MCP setup; source configuration needs no engagement record and credentials stay with the host.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你把外部数据源的访问配通并排错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把外部数据源接进工具里,却卡在连接和凭据配置上。
copy.tagline_en: Set up and troubleshoot access to external data sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hook an external data source into your tools but keep getting stuck on access setup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用主机上已有的工具，配置或诊断对指定数据源的访问；凭据留在主机，配置源不需要 engagement record。能力缺失或没跑的检查会如实报告，不会假装已就绪。
howto.when: 当你需要做 source MCP 设置，或要配置、诊断某个数据源的访问时触发。若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前已脱敏的 packet 与范围，不重新开始设置或提问。

say.text: 帮我配置一下这个数据源的 MCP 访问
say.note: 会先读任务上下文和方法再动手

say.text: 检查我对这个源的访问是否正常
say.note: 只做配置与能力检查，凭据留在主机

say.text: 这个源连不上，帮我诊断一下
say.note: 缺失的能力会如实报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude configures or diagnoses access to a requested source using host tools. Credentials stay on the host and source configuration needs no engagement record; missing capabilities are reported honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need source MCP setup, or want to configure or diagnose access to a source. Called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting.

say_en.text: Help me configure MCP access to this source
say_en.note: Reads task context and method first

say_en.text: Check whether my access to this source works
say_en.note: Config checks only; credentials stay on the host

say_en.text: This source won't connect — help me diagnose it
